name: GitHub
description: Pull requests on GitHub: list, read, see check results and open a new one. It cannot merge, close or delete anything.
author: Lily

settings.name: token
settings.label: GitHub token
settings.description: A fine-grained token limited to the repositories you choose, with Pull requests (read and write) and Checks (read).

tools.name: gh_list_prs
tools.description: List the newest open pull requests of a repository (5 at most).

params.name: owner
params.description: Account or organisation that owns the repository.

tools.name: gh_get_pr
tools.description: Read one pull request: title, description, branches, state and the head commit sha.

params.name: owner
params.description: Account or organisation that owns the repository.

tools.name: gh_pr_checks
tools.description: Check results (passed, failed, running) for a commit. Use the head commit sha from gh_get_pr.

params.name: owner
params.description: Account or organisation that owns the repository.

params.name: sha
params.description: Full commit sha (40 hex characters), not a branch name.

tools.name: gh_create_pr
tools.description: Open a pull request from a branch that is already pushed. Asks you every time.

params.name: owner
params.description: Account or organisation that owns the repository.

params.name: head
params.description: Branch with the changes (owner:branch from a fork).

params.name: base
params.description: Branch to merge into, usually main.
